title: ExamGuard Synthetic Dataset Data Quality & Integrity Report

missingTelemetry.handlingPolicy: Missing channels are omitted from question-level averages rather than treated as zeros. At scoring time, missing session channels impute the baseline mean mu_j (z_j = 0).
